identity_constraints: Preserve the original 2D silhouette, tip, lobes/notches, substantial red outer shape and nested orange/cream contours and relative widths. A brief natural blink may close and reopen both eyes, returning promptly to those original ovals. Keep the face attached to the body. Preserve the short rounded red-orange arms shown in the mascot examples, including shape, thickness, length and attachment points. Do not turn them into long arms or large separate hands.
Feet are two tiny rounded red vertical nubs peeking directly below the flame body, at original proportions. No lower-leg shaft, ankle, boot-like toe, shoes or fingers.
Keep the same mouthless mascot across every visible scene and throughout motion. Pose and perspective change while character features and anatomy stay consistent.
Apply the painted treatment to those same source shapes; do not copy redesigned anatomy from a previously generated frame.
Keep hands empty in the escalator scenes. Example props and accessories are not part of the neutral mascot.

Small bouncy flame-like body/tip follow-through is allowed when Sol moves; layers and face travel together coherently, with unchanged open navy eye ovals and constant stubby limb lengths. Scripted paired eye-gaze shifts inside the face are allowed for that attention cue; they are distinct from unmotivated facial drift.
